title: CAReDiO: Cultural Alignment of LLM via Representativeness and Distinctiveness Guided Data Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cultural alignment and Western-centric bias in Large Language Models using multiple benchmarks. This includes measuring the similarity of the model's predicted probability distributions to global opinion surveys (GlobalOpinionQA), testing the accuracy of region-specific cultural knowledge using true/false questions (CulturalBench), and using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) to score the cultural awareness, nuances, and quality of responses to open-ended culture-related prompts (CultureBank, Prism).
